seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: axis 10, target 11 solid, reflection 4, piece 5 rings with holes.
A1/A2 move the selected axis or piece one block row; A3/A4 move a piece one column; pieces are blocked by the board edge and by other pieces, not by the axis.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces (largest first) -> axis. Each piece block reflects to row 2A-r; no reflection is drawn on blocks a piece covers.
HUD col 63 = one 12 cell per effective action (no-ops do not count); past 64 actions, 5s fill from the top. Static scenery is re-rendered from the parse.
Unconfirmed: HUD behaviour at n>=128, and piece order on A5 ties.
